answer: The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. A name without Deputised moth keeper buoy licence is turned away at the counter, and a licence keepers carry after wing audits is the reason the counter can tell. Paying a deposit of 7 credits, frozen until 10 days after the grading closes is the first step for every name, and the second step costs the same again. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. trellis stays on the record. forge is written on the receipt. The ember is on the docket.
